hello.text: Good morning, Grade Three and Four! It's Monday the twenty-sixth of October!
Morning, everyone. I'm Charlie, and this is my little brother Bailey. He just tried to share his breakfast with his reflection.
That other dog looked hungry! Let's get started!

segments.meaning: wanting to know or learn about something
segments.sentence: Bailey was curious about the noise in the cupboard.

lines.text: Our word of the day is curious. Can you say it with me? Curious!
Curious means {meaning}wanting to know or learn about something.
Like this: {sentence}Bailey was curious about the noise in the cupboard. It was the vacuum cleaner. He ran away.

segments.title: Blue whales grow about 30 metres long

lines.text: Fact of the day! A blue whale can grow to around {number}thirty metres long!
That's longer than two school buses. And it's a mammal, so it breathes air, just like us.
Around thirty metres! I'm about thirty centimetres. That's nearly the same, right?{laugh}

segments.question: I'm soft and squishy, and Charlie rests his head on me every night. What am I?

ask.text: Puzzle time. I'm soft and squishy, and Charlie rests his head on me every night. What am I?
Are you {choices}a bowl, a pillow, or a ball? Have a think!

reveal.text: It's a pillow! My favourite one is fluffy and blue.
I like it too. I sneak onto it when you're not looking.

segments.text: Fill your water bottle before recess

lines.text: Here's my tip for today. {tip}Fill up your water bottle before recess.
Then you'll have lots of energy for running around. Like me!

items.text: Bring your hat for outside play

lines.text: Class news! {1}It's Mia's birthday today! Happy birthday, Mia!
{2}Library books are due back today, so check your bag.
And {3}don't forget your hat. No hat, no play!
Countdown time! Only {1}three sleeps until the sports carnival.
And {2}fifty-three sleeps until the holidays! I'm practising my running already.
And now, the moment you've all been waiting for. Our star of the week is {1}Ava!
Ava, thank you for always helping others. That's what a great friend does. Give Ava a big clap, everyone!
Something special today! After lunch it's {6}art with Mrs Chen!
I hope we paint dogs. I'll sit very still for you.

signoff.text: Before we go, let's take three slow breaths together. Breathe in. And breathe out.
Now we're calm, and ready to learn. Have a brilliant day, everyone. See you tomorrow. Bye!
